market.what: leach reagents (mostly sulfuric acid) bought by copper heap/dump leach ops, world; the budget a leach additive sells into
market.method: est. 4.7 Mt SX-EW Cu x ~4 t acid/t Cu x ~$150/t = $2.8B; check: Chile alone 8.5 Mt acid x $165/t = $1.4B

value.logic: CRU: catalyst-leach TAM 4.9-7.2 Mt Cu/yr; if additives unlock 0.5 Mt/yr extra Cu x ~$10k/t margin (LME $14.7k/t less ~$4.4k/t leach cost) = $5B/yr
value.revenue_logic: Jetti-style value share: 1-2 mine partners, 30 kt/yr extra Cu x $14.7k/t x 5% share
value.margin_logic: value-priced additive dosed at mM levels; reagent cost small vs copper value

trend.drivers: grid/EV copper demand; IEA sees 30% mined-supply gap by 2035; falling grades; Freeport leach output 200 Mlb (2025) to 800 Mlb target 2030; Chile acid squeeze 2026

competition.notes: Jetti strongest: $100M Series D at $2.5B, BHP/Freeport backed, thiocarbonyl (ETU-type) patents with UBC = FTO risk for thiourea designs; Ceibo $30M+ Series B, demo cathode Jun 2025; Endolith $13.5M; Still Bright $18.7M seed 2025

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: s0 is an N-acyl thiourea/thiocarbamate; 3 variants from isothiocyanate + amine
lab.test: stirred-reactor leach of chalcopyrite concentrate (2 mM additive, ORP/pH held, vs ETU and blank), Cu by ICP-OES/AAS; then mini-column leach on low-grade ore; UBC/ALS/SGS hydromet labs
lab.logic: synth 5 wk + reactor tests 3 wk + mini-columns ~8 wk; 3 x $6k CRO + reactor work ~$7k + columns ~$20k (est.)

sale.gates: large columns on mine ore 6-12 mo; test heap/crib 1 yr; toxicity and SX-EW circuit compatibility check; value-share deal
